nom: Caudalie Vinoperfect Brightening Glycolic Acid Peel Mask - 75 mL

avis.texte: I have had severe sun damage and medication dark spots that nothing would touch! I used this stuff and it transformed my face and décolletage I’d be so happy to share before and during but sadly I just changed phones and iCloud deleted all of my photos. I’m still trying to figure out how. I highly recommend this and the other of their products that I used which I’m in the process of writing reviews. BTW, I have exceedingly sensitive skin and this did not bother it at all, I feel that is important to mention. I can’t even use any type of bandaids and I have a hormone imbalance that cause my skin to get very raw layers peel off and again this did not burn or anything.
Gentle but effective. Gets the job done but could use a little bit more oomph. I really do enjoy this product but I’m used to using something a bit stronger.

I really enjoy this product! I pretty much put a decent amount on almost as if it’s a lotion. I leave it on for about 10 minutes or so and rinse with like warm water. Once my face is dried off my skin feels SO clean. I don’t have horrible acne or anything but I will get a couple pimples from time to time. When using this mask about two times weekly I haven’t had any issues with pimples. I would have to say my ONLY complaint is how much it costs..

avis.texte: I got my mom and my son to use this peel with me. We all enjoyed it. I bought it for help with my excessive patches of (color). This didn't really help with my excess of melanin patches. (PS I'm way too young to have age spots & spend very little time in the sun.)

Love, love, love this stuff! You will even see a subtle improvement right after you wash off the product. And the aroma is pleasant, too...none of that cheap chemical smell that other products have. Very high quality and worth the cost!!!
It feels nice going on, but I really didn't see any results and for the price, that's kind of wack .
I have used this for years and love it; all of their products are great.

avis.texte: Arrived promptly, been using caudalie for 2 years great for my skin and works well

avis.titre: Molto delicata, lascia la pelle fresca
avis.texte: Ho la pelle molto chiara e sensibile, soggetta a couperose e arrossamenti, per questo cercavo un prodotto che fosse super-delicato: Caudalie è sempre una garanzia. È un esfoliante davvero delicato che lascia la pelle molto fresca. Ho 44 e lo ritengo un prodotto valido anche per chi, come me, non è più una ragazza (ma per adesso ancora lo sembra!) ;)
I used this twice and saw no dramatic change! Maybe my skin is used to slightly stronger stuff. Overall it is a gentle mask, clean skin well and decent for almost everyday use.
